design_archetype.rationale: Cloud storage requires absolute trust, clarity of data, and high structural organization. Dark theme ensures focus on content and reduced eye strain.

color_palette.notes: STRICT USAGE: The theme is dark mode ONLY. Use #0B1F3A for the main app background. Use #0F172A for nested surfaces like the sidebar, cards, and modals. #F1F5F9 should be used sparingly for extremely high-contrast active states or inverse chips if needed, but not as a main background.

typography.body_font: IBM Plex Sans, sans-serif (or System regular)

spacing_and_layout.touch_targets: Minimum 44x44px for all touchable elements (buttons, icons, links)

responsive_behavior.mobile: Sidebar transforms into a slide-in Drawer. Single column layouts.
responsive_behavior.tablet_web: Persistent left sidebar. Grid layouts (2-4 columns depending on width).

buttons.action_circular: Background: #0F172A, Icon: #3B82F6, Rounded: full. (Used on file cards)

sidebar.active_state: Background: #0B1F3A, Text: #3B82F6, Left border accent: 3px solid #2563EB
sidebar.layout: Top: Logo + Wordmark. Middle: Navigation links. Bottom: Storage widget, Upgrade CTA, User Row, Sign Out.

cards.dashboard_upload: Large dashed border area, Background: #0B1F3A / #0F172A gradient, Icon: giant blue upload icon.
cards.stat_tiles: Background: #0F172A, padding: 16px, rounded: 12px, Value text: 24px #FFFFFF, Label text: 14px #94A3B8.
cards.file_folder_cards: Background: #0F172A, padding: 16px. Folders have large blue folder icon + 'Double-click to open'. Files show generic icon + 3 circular action buttons (download, share, trash).
cards.plan_cards: Background: #0F172A, border: 1px solid #0B1F3A. Active/Popular plan has glowing border (#3B82F6) and floating 'Most Popular' pill.

navigation_elements.quick_access_chips: Background: #0B1F3A, Text: #FFFFFF, Border: 1px solid #94A3B8. Rounded: Pill.
navigation_elements.breadcrumbs: Text: #94A3B8 for parents, #FFFFFF for current directory. Separator: '/'

implementation_rules.icons: Use ONLY @expo/vector-icons (Ionicons, MaterialCommunityIcons, Feather). NO EMOJIS.
implementation_rules.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include `data-testid` attribute. Use role-based naming (e.g. `data-testid='upload-dropzone'`).
implementation_rules.styling_approach: Use Expo StyleSheet or NativeWind. Ensure cross-platform compatibility (.js extensions). Use 'flex' for all layouts.
implementation_rules.dark_mode: Strictly Dark Mode. Do not implement a light theme.
